text: A Cargo-installed papercuts binary was absent from PATH even though Cargo itself was available; invoking papercuts by name failed. A repository wrapper that also checks the Cargo bin directory would have prevented it.

note: Root cause: Cargo binaries were installed under CARGO_HOME/bin while that directory was not on PATH. Durable fix: scripts/papercuts prefers PATH, falls back to the Cargo bin directory, and enforces v0.2.0. Verified with ./scripts/papercuts --version and ./scripts/papercuts doctor.

text: papercuts 0.2.0 list --status all --format md marks resolved entries but omits resolution.note, hiding the reusable solution. Searching the pretty JSON output would have exposed the resolution.

note: Root cause: the v0.2.0 Markdown renderer does not include resolution.note. Workaround: use ./scripts/papercuts --pretty list --status all when searching prior problems and solutions. Verified that the JSON item includes status and the complete resolution object.

text: analyze-via-sonar skill: token 'vigilant-local-analysis' existed but its value was persisted nowhere (.claude/sonar.env held only SONAR_ADMIN_PASSWORD), so generate failed with 'already exists' and the run needed revoke+regen, silently invalidating a possibly live token. Persisting SONAR_TOKEN in .claude/sonar.env and reusing it would have prevented this.

note: Root cause: skill step 2 never persisted the generated token. Durable fix: SKILL.md step 2 now reads SONAR_TOKEN from .claude/sonar.env first (validates via GET /api/system/status, 200 = reuse), falls back to revoke+generate, and appends the fresh token to .claude/sonar.env (gitignored). Current token already stored. Verified: git check-ignore .claude/sonar.env -> IGNORED.

text: Full ./gradlew build (with JaCoCo+detekt overhead) failed once in BypassProxyServiceTest 'proxies method path query headers body and response' with UnprocessedRequestException/SessionProtocolNegotiationException: connection established, but session creation timed out (gateway WebClient.of() -> test upstream). Plain ./gradlew test and isolated rerun of the same suite passed. Library-default WebClient has no explicit timeouts/pooling - exactly the VIG-05-05 gap. Recording until VIG-05-05 lands explicit client config; recheck flake rate after it.

Read-only Codex CLI smoke with codex exec --ephemeral emitted a stale models-cache error (missing base_instructions), remote plugin-catalog 429/500 warning, and repeated state-db discrepancy warnings before a successful answer. The warnings bury the behavioral result; a cache repair path or quieter graceful fallback would have prevented this.

Metrics E2E tests read OTel data immediately after client response aggregation, but MetricsService publishes completion metrics asynchronously from RequestLog.whenComplete; full-suite timing exposed a missing-metric race that isolated runs hid. A shared deadline-bounded metric await helper prevents this flake.

note: Root cause: RequestLog completion callbacks may publish metrics after client aggregation completes, so direct reads raced. Durable fix: MetricsServiceTest.awaitMetric polls the OTel reader with a 5-second deadline for completion metrics. Verified: ./gradlew test --tests 'io.vigilant.gateway.metrics.*' passed all 8 tests.

text: Verification pipeline could report PASS with report-only OWASP and stale or empty Sonar scope

note: Fail-closed OWASP threshold preflight; explicit Sonar scope, async-task polling, project-key check, infrastructure exit code, and bounded Docker preflight

text: OtlpMetricsExportTest flaked in full suite (404 on /v1/models, single-run green): ServerSocket(0).use{localPort} reserved a port from the OS ephemeral range - the same pool fixture servers bind via http(0), so a fixture could steal it before the child JVM bound. Prevented by reserving the child port from below the ephemeral range and holding ServerSocket until launch.

note: Root cause: port TOCTOU between test JVM and child gateway JVM over the shared ephemeral pool. Fix: reserveGatewayPort() in OtlpMetricsExportTest binds a verified port in 1024..49151 (below macOS ephemeral range 49152+) so fixture http(0) servers cannot be handed it. Verification: ./gradlew test --tests io.vigilant.gateway.metrics.OtlpMetricsExportTest plus full ./gradlew test green.

text: RTK wrapper rejects find compound predicates even though global instructions require prefixing every shell command with rtk; using rg --files for repository inventory avoids the unsupported syntax.

note: RTK find intentionally rejects compound predicates. Durable repository-inventory workaround: use rtk rg --files with include/exclude globs. Verified against the full tracked file inventory for this review.

text: Concurrent Gradle builds can corrupt build/test-results when a yielded exec session is mistaken for completion; preserve and poll the session id before starting another Gradle command.

note: Root cause: a yielded exec session id was discarded and a second Gradle build started before the first had definitely completed, racing over build/test-results. Durable workflow: retain the session id, poll it to exit, and use one --no-daemon verification build. Verified by ./gradlew build --no-daemon completing GREEN in 3m 33s.

text: Official SWIFT IBAN registry downloads were reachable through the browser/web fetcher but stalled with zero bytes through shell curl, so direct artifact ingestion could not be used; documenting a supported source-fetch path or checked-in provenance generation script would prevent rediscovery.

note: Shell curl remained unusable for swift.com, but the official release 102 PDF was accessible through the web fetcher. Verified source version, all 89 country codes, and uncertain/new lengths from the PDF, then pinned them in a provenance-headed resource covered by IbanCountryLengthsTest. Reuse the web PDF path when direct download stalls.

text: prepareRedMadRobotPiiCorpus created its temporary download target before Files.copy but omitted REPLACE_EXISTING, so the explicit network path failed with FileAlreadyExistsException; use replacement copy into the owned temp file.

note: Root cause: Files.createTempFile makes the target exist, while Files.copy(InputStream, Path) rejects an existing target by default. Added StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING for the owned temp target. Verified: ./gradlew prepareRedMadRobotPiiCorpus downloaded, checked, and published the pinned file successfully.
